title: VideoTemp-o3: Harmonizing Temporal Grounding and Video Understanding in Agentic Thinking-with-Videos

problems.name: Long-Video Evidence Sparsity and Efficient Selection
problems.evidence_sentence: Experimental results demonstrate that our method achieves remarkable performance on both long video understanding and grounding. # Abstract In long-video understanding, conventional uniform frame sampling often fails to capture key visual evidence, leading to degraded performance and increased hallucinations.

problems.name: LLM Temporal Reasoning and Time Output Instability
problems.evidence_sentence: Experimental results demonstrate that our method achieves remarkable performance on both long video understanding and grounding. # Introduction Although Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) (Bai et al., 2025; Team et al., 2025b;a) have made remarkable advances, their internal knowledge remains static once trained, limiting their capacity to tackle complex tasks in dynamic environments.

problems.name: Dataset, Benchmark, and Evaluation Mismatch
problems.evidence_sentence: Besides, from the data perspective, we develop an effective pipeline to construct high-quality long video grounded QA data, along with a corresponding benchmark for systematic evaluation across various video durations.

methods.name: LLM Reasoning, Agentic Workflows, or RL Post-Training
methods.evidence_sentence: Later works like VITAL (Zhang et al., 2025a), REVISOR (Li et al., 2025a), and LongVT (Yang et al., 2025) adopt hybrid training that combines Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and Reinforcement Learning (RL) on curated datasets, enabling models to effectively identify key segments and produce accurate responses.

methods.name: Coarse-to-Fine or Hierarchical Localization
